config.experiment: H-D1 PILOT self-ref-trace-contrast (kb/ideas/self-ref-trace-contrast.md as committed in ca58d61) + docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 12; pilot under D-014, does not count toward the stop rule

vae.name: sd-vae-ft-mse
vae.io: 009's recon_f/q8 (uint8 -> [-1,1] -> encode -> latent_dist.mode() -> decode -> (y+1)/2 clamp -> rint uint8; fp32, TF32 off; GPU batch <= 4, grouped by image size)

rows.train_reals: 297 train-split reals (99 native, 99 WA, 99 FBH; 10 devices): probes, orientation, blur sigma
rows.calib_natives: 43 calib-split natives (same 10 devices as train, other photos): alternative threshold calibration + texture sign
rows.test_reals: 1,074 test-split reals (358 per pool, 25 devices disjoint from train)
rows.fakes: 720 Synthbuster fakes (6 generators x 120); all 720 are scored (011 convention); only the train-split fakes (360) set the texture sign
rows.vv: second round-trip VAE(VAE(x)) at clean for the 297 train reals and the 358 test natives

config.observed_image: t = apply_condition(raw crop, cond) (004 load_cond), then center-cropped to a multiple of 8 per side (t'; identical for 512 and 256, <= 3 px for social_sim). Every quantity below uses t'. VAE(t') is the raw uint8 output (no JPEG/PNG re-save) for both classes in both arms.
config.phi: DINOv2-base blocks 4/8/12 CLS+mean (004 secondary, 4608-d, 224 center crop, batch 20, TF32 off)

L0.definition: perturb.jpeg75_resize05 (resize x0.5 bicubic, JPEG q75), applied to BOTH t' and VAE(t') (after the VAE)
L0.primary_rule: min: if the L0 output is shorter than 224 on a side (observed image already 256^2 -> 128^2, or social_sim < 448), bicubic-resize it back to the pre-L0 size (Amendment 9 precedent); otherwise leave it at half size (literal 011 pipeline for clean 512 inputs)
L0.sensitivity_rule: uniform: always bicubic back to the pre-L0 size (Amendment 9 canonicalization applied uniformly). Reported as 'Bu'; does not affect the label.

scores.A: shift = d_p(phi(VAE t')) - d_p(phi(t')); d_p = decision function of E4's PRIMARY F2 probe (fit on CLEAN train pairs, refit here with the same code and verified against 011/results.json); fake-score = -shift
scores.B: shift = d_m(phi(L0 VAE t')) - d_m(phi(L0 t')); d_m = E4's MATCHED F2 probe (fit on jpeg75_resize05 train pairs); fake-score = -shift; THE LABEL SCORE
scores.Bu: B with the uniform L0 rule (sensitivity)
scores.A2: logistic probe (grouped CV, balanced, 011/009 e2.fit) on Delta vectors, positives Delta1 = phi(VAE x) - phi(x), negatives Delta2 = phi(VAE VAE x) - phi(VAE x), 297 train reals each, clean, raw (no L0); score = -decision(phi(VAE t') - phi(t'))
scores.A2L: same with L0 on all four images (descriptive extension of A2; the idea file does not say whether A2 uses L0)
scores.orientation: fixed on train pairs: round-trip = class 1, a real photo shifts positively; fake-score = -shift. Never flipped on test.

baselines.pooled_F2: d_p(phi(t')) (and d_m(phi(t')) as 'F2m'), single-image, fake-score = +decision (011 transfer convention); 011 reference values (0.892/0.665 fov512, 0.776/0.643 orig at clean/laundered) are checked against the refit
baselines.texture: mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of the gray 224 center crop of t' (009 lap224); sign set per condition on calib natives vs train-split fakes (009 convention, Amendment 6), never flipped
baselines.pixel_L2: -RMS(t' - VAE(t')) over all pixels in [0,1], fake-score = -RMS (AEROBLADE premise, fixed a priori, L2 instead of LPIPS); the flipped orientation is reported descriptively
baselines.B0_LOGO: 005 pilot A0 LOGO-macro AUROC quoted from 005/pilot/results.json (reference only; arm of that file is the 005 splits)

blur_control.definition: the same score with VAE(t') replaced by GaussianBlur(t', sigma)
blur_control.sigma: chosen per (arm, condition, score A or B) on the 297 TRAIN reals observed in that condition so that the mean shift of the blur equals the mean shift of the VAE round-trip (grid below, log-linear interpolation between the bracketing grid points; out-of-range flagged)
blur_control.rule: diffusion-specific only if laundered AUROC(B) - AUROC(blur B) >= 0.05 with the paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; else the label is 'not diffusion-specific' whatever the AUROC

gates.1_saturation: test natives, clean, w = primary F2: median(w.Delta2) <= 0.5 * median(w.Delta1), Delta1 = phi(VAE x) - phi(x), Delta2 = phi(VAE VAE x) - phi(VAE x); else UNINFORMATIVE
gates.2_content_cancellation: Spearman(w.phi(t'), w.phi(VAE t')) >= 0.8 on the 358 test natives; evaluated for the label score B (w matched, L0 features) in EVERY condition and for A; the gate passes iff B passes in every condition
gates.3_orientation: fixed on train pairs (above); recorded: fraction of train reals with positive shift, A2 in-sample AUROC
gates.4_d008: |dlogit| <= 1e-3 on 32 fixed images (16 test natives + 16 fakes) for every score, GPU vs CPU DINOv2 features of the stored VAE outputs; VAE pixel guard reused from 009 (same weights revision and recon function)
gates.5_validity_A6_A8: B clean AUROC CI lower bound > 0.5 AND B clean AUROC > texture clean AUROC (Amendments 6/8 reading)

pass: B laundered macro >= 0.80, CI lo >= 0.75, and >= pooled F2 (primary, laundered) + 0.10
non-SD group (dalle2, dalle3, firefly, midjourney-v5) macro laundered >= 0.75
B beats texture and pixel-L2 by >= 0.10 (point) in every condition
FPR <= 2.0% at the 1% threshold, on the test natives, WA and FBH copies, in every condition
pass_fail.label_arm: fov512 (orig reported with the same rules)

fpr_rule.primary: cross-fit over DEVICES: the 25 test devices are split into two halves (seeded, balanced); the threshold is calibrated on the natives of one half (lib/metrics.threshold_for_fpr at 1%) and applied to the natives, WA and FBH copies of the OTHER half's devices; pooled over both folds. Calibrated per condition.
fpr_rule.alternative: threshold from the 43 calib-split natives, applied to all test natives / WA / FBH (calib devices are train devices, so this is held-out photos, not held-out devices)

config.bootstrap: e2.Plan: test natives by device, fakes by image stratified per generator, 2000 replicates, one plan for all scores (paired); per-pool plans use the same seed (identical device draws)

orientation.note: shift>0 for a real photo (round-trip = class 1); fake-score = -shift; fixed, never flipped on test
